messages:
olivia: Quick heads-up: doing a minimal base-image rebuild Friday 07:30 PT. Objectives: remove CAP_NET_RAW/CAP_SYS_ADMIN where feasible, enable userns remap, and switch keystore operator to per-cluster envelope keys.

diego: rolling canary? what's the blast radius plan?

olivia: yes. internal-canary -> staging -> prod-canary -> fleet. 10–20m windows + automated health checks and vuln-scan + cosign verification after each step.

marie: RBAC housekeeping first — bake-runner SA still has broad bindings in infra namespaces. I’ll prepare a migration PR to tighten to just job permissions and add annotations for SOC tracking.

eldar: KMS detail: will new cluster KEKs be separate aliases or versions on same key? we prefer separate aliases so we can revoke per-cluster.

olivia: separate aliases per-cluster. infra will create keys and grant keystore-operator kms:Encrypt/kms:Decrypt scoped to the cluster alias.

marie: audit/logs: SOC asked for 1y WORM retention and attestable provenance. plan: write logs to WORM bucket encrypted with cluster KEK and store a signed manifest (cosign) for each batch. ops-bot: ticket SEC-5991 opened for retention + manifest schema.

diego: build pipeline changes — add SBOM and cosign attestation. also ensure reproducible build flags in the Dockerfile.

olivia: yes. CI will produce SBOM, sign it with cosign, and attach as secret to the image tag.

eldar: incident runbook item: if rewrap fails during cutover, fallback path is to decrypt with previous KEK and re-encrypt. who owns the runbook?

marie: I’ll own runbook steps with eldars help. adding a short-lived admin impersonation step for oncall. include explicit gcloud command examples.

olivia: snippet for rollout engineers to validate before promoting:
```
# ensure no NET_RAW capability remains
kubectl get pods -o jsonpath='{.items[*].spec.containers[*].securityContext.capabilities.drop}' | grep NET_RAW && echo BAD || echo OK
# cosign verify
cosign verify --bundle -key k8s://projects/redwood/keys/cosign registry.redwood/base:sha
# verify userns remap is active
grep -q userns /proc/filesystems || echo userns-missing
```

diego: RBAC change must include audit annotation like `sec.redwood/audit=SEC-5991` on Role/RoleBinding metadata. SOC needs that to correlate.

marie: noted. also plan to remove any `system:masters` and replace with narrowly-scoped ClusterRoles. will document the exact diff in PR.

eldar: post-deploy health checks:
1) cosign verify passes for the deployed image
2) vuln-scan reports zero criticals for the baseline images
3) keystore operator logs show successful Rewrap for >95% requests within 5m

olivia: rollback plan: re-tag previous image as fallback and keep previous keystore operator container image in a disabled deployment (cold standby) so we can re-enable if rewrap fails.

ops-bot: deploy-checklist: [ ] RBAC migration PR merged (annotated), [ ] cluster KEKs provisioned, [ ] cosign signer rotated & tested, [ ] SBOM + attestation pipeline green, [ ] canary schedule, [ ] runbook attached to SEC-5991.

diego: I’ll take RBAC PR and pair with marie at 1pm to ensure no overlooked bindings.

marie: legal/compliance signoff? legal only if retention schema changes; SOC already looped. I’ll CC legal on SEC-5991 for visibility.

eldar: small edge-case — legacy debug sidecars use pcap and need NET_RAW. proposal: move them to a restricted debug daemonset in a dedicated nodepool rather than granting capabilities to app pods.

olivia: agreed. include in infra PR.

marie: monitoring: attach alert if any cluster reports >3 failed rewrap attempts in a 10m window or if cosign verify fails for promoted tag. That should auto-trigger incident runbook.

ops-bot: reminder: 30m pre-cutover ping in #release-war-room.

diego: will update the PRs and run the preflight checks.

olivia: thanks team — final owners updated in SEC-5991 and I'll post a 30m heads-up before flip. :lock:
